# lua-sandbox

> Embed Lua 5.5 with enforced memory, instruction, call depth and output limits, a whitelisted standard library, text-only chunks and typed host function bindings C++20 library `lua-sandbox`, namespace `trysac::lua_sandbox`, CMake target
> `trysac::lua_sandbox`, MIT licensed, standard library only.

- [README](README.md): problem, install, usage example
- [AGENTS](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions, limits
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): shape of the library and its public API
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
